data.student_scan_interval: Roster and ID scan update interval

data_description.bus_scan_interval: How often the live bus position is refreshed. The app itself refreshes every 15 seconds.
data_description.student_scan_interval: How often stop details and ID scan history are refreshed.
data_description.rider_tracker: Only consulted on an afternoon with no badge scan, to tell a rider who is on the bus from one who stayed at school. Its position when the window opens is compared with its position once the bus has gone: travelled, and with the bus, means aboard. Leave empty to rely on the scan alone. An iCloud3 tracker is asked directly for a fresh fix, which takes a few seconds; any other tracker is read at whatever rate it updates itself.
